high_level_description: This is a black-and-white photograph of a person taking a mirror selfie. The individual appears to be indoors, possibly in a bathroom or a similar setting, as suggested by the tiled wall and the presence of a light fixture above the mirror. The person has long, wavy hair that falls over their shoulders. They are wearing a dark-colored sweater with a patterned design, which includes lighter-colored diamond shapes. Underneath the sweater, they have on a white shirt. They are also wearing a necklace and a watch on their left wrist. A handbag with a distinctive logo is slung over their shoulder.
